sn35.77:1.1: Yaṃ kho Rādha dukkhaṃ tatra te chando pahātabbo || || 5-10

sn35.77:1.12: Yam pidam manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkham asukhaṃ vā || tam pi dukkhaṃ || tatra te chando pahātabbo || || 11
sn35.77:1.13: Yaṃ kho Rādha dukkhaṃ tatra te chando pahātabboti || || 4
